name: Devano
bio:
Devano (born September 23, 2002, in Indramayu, West Java) is an Indonesian singer, actor, and model, as well as the son of renowned dangdut singer Iis Dahlia and Satrio Dewandono. He first gained public attention after making his debut in the entertainment industry in 2017 as a singer, with popular songs such as Menyimpan Rasa (2018) and Ini Aku, which established him as a promising young musician. In addition to music, Devano expanded his career into acting, making his film debut in Dear Nathan: Hello Salma (2018), before achieving wider recognition through his roles in the series My Nerd Girl (2022–2024) and Bad Boys vs Crazy Girls.

Throughout his career, Devano has been recognized as a multitalented figure capable of balancing both music and acting consistently. In 2026, at the age of 24, he decided to adopt the stage name “Devano,” dropping “Danendra” as part of a personal branding strategy to make his name simpler, more memorable, and stronger in the entertainment industry. This change reflects his growing maturity and his commitment to continuously evolving as a public figure in Indonesia.
